user.title: Connect Deglaze (proof of concept)
user.description: Enter the email address used for Deglaze. In the next step, paste a fresh sign-in link from your Deglaze email. Do not open/click the link before pasting it here, because the one-time code may be consumed.

link.title: Complete email-link sign-in
link.description: Request a sign-in email through the Deglaze website, copy the full link from the email, and paste it below. The link contains a one-time credential; it is sent directly from Home Assistant to Firebase and is not stored in the config entry or written to logs.

data.sign_in_link: Full sign-in link from the Deglaze email

error.invalid_link: This is not a recognized Deglaze Firebase sign-in link. Request a fresh link and paste it without opening it.
error.invalid_auth: The link is expired or already used. Request a new Deglaze sign-in email and try again.
error.auth_failed: Firebase rejected the sign-in link. Verify the account email and try a fresh link.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not complete sign-in or retrieve the Deglaze grocery list. Check connectivity and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Deglaze account is already configured.
